_comment: Shared by crates/agent-theme/tests/shared_cases.rs and the portal's theme tests, so the Rust validator and the Dart mapper apply the same rules (docs/design/visual/07-testing.md). expected: {"ok": "0xAARRGGBB"} or {"err": "<ThemeErrorKind>"}. An input may be built as prefix + repeat*count to keep huge cases small here.
